title: Tempered circuit vasculature and tenant throttle sanitizer
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: During a regional degradation incident we observed rapid circuit flapping and disproportionate tenant throttling that amplified tail latency and caused unnecessary failovers. This change introduces a tempered circuit 'vasculature' (fine-grained weighted circuit state propagation) and a tenant throttle sanitizer that smooths transient token-bucket noise while preserving SLO enforcement. Goals: 1) reduce oscillation of circuit open/close across nodes, 2) avoid overaggressive tenant-level shedding on short bursts, 3) provide observable, auditable transitions for post-incident analysis. Changes: - Implement windowed circuit propagation with decay + jitter to avoid synchronized flips across a region. - Replace hard tenant immediate-cutoff with a sanitizer stage that applies a short, exponentially-backoff probation window and a soft-capacity clamp. - Add telemetry hooks: circuit_transition_reason tag, tenant_sanitizer_state metric, and a short-lived audit log for transition snapshots. - New unit & integration tests that exercise short high-frequency bursts and long sustained overloads. Rollout: staged canary (5% of regional traffic) for 48 hours, followed by 50% for 24 hours, then full rollout pending metrics sanity. Rollback plan: feature flag 'tempered_circuit_v1' and an emergency off playbook; manual rollback script included. Checklist: - [x] Design doc RFC linked (docs/rfc/tempered-circuit.md) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests verifying stability under burst load - [x] Telemetry dashboards updated - [x] Canary rollout plan attached Testing notes: Locally I ran the synthetic burst harness (bench/perf/burst_sim.py) across 10 tenants and validated that 95th latency improved by ~18% in burst windows and that circuit flip rate dropped by ~72%. Observability: added new Grafana panel to track circuit flip rate and tenant sanitizer rejections. Related: ENG-3456 (post-incident follow-up), SUP-98 (customer-reported surge behavior).
commits: 3 commits: 1) core: add tempered propagation and decay with jitter (runtime/circuit) 2) runtime: tenant throttle sanitizer + feature flag + metrics 3) tests/docs: integration tests, RFC and dashboards update
diff_snippets:
--- a/runtime/circuit/propagation.go
+++ b/runtime/circuit/propagation.go
@@ -12,6 +12,18 @@
 func propagateState(nodeState State) {
-    broadcast(nodeState)
+    // apply jittered decay to avoid synchronized flips
+    jitter := time.Duration(rand.Intn(150)) * time.Millisecond
+    go func() {
+        time.Sleep(jitter)
+        decayed := decay(nodeState, 0.85)
+        broadcast(decayed)
+    }()
 }
review_comments: Marco Nguyen: This generally LGTM; two asks: (1) can we make jitter configurable via helm for faster rollback tuning, (2) add a small e2e that asserts no region-wide simultaneous open events? Author reply (Aisha Patel): Done — added helm config and an e2e 'simultaneous_open_guard' that runs in CI integration stage.

Ravi Desai: Concern about metric cardinality from per-transition audit logs. Suggest sampling transitions at 10% and aggregating buckets. Author reply (Aisha Patel): Implemented sampling gate in scripts/rollback_probe.sh; added tenant_sanitizer_state as a coarse enum metric to keep cardinality low.

Sofia Martinez: Can we guarantee safety for private deployments with on-prem KMS/HSM because the audit blob contained tenant IDs? Author reply (Aisha Patel): Switched audit payload to hashed tenant-id (sha256) and added opt-out via helm value 'audit.sanitizeTenant=false' defaulting to true.
ci_summary: Initial CI run failed lint on tenant_sanitizer.go (unused import); fixed in commit 2 and re-ran. Integration suite passed under the burst harness profile; deployment lint and helm template checks passed.
merge_outcome: Merged into main via squash by Marco Nguyen after approvals on 2026-02-20
release_notes: Hotfix: Reduce circuit flipstorm and smooth tenant throttling; improves burst 95th latency and reduces regional failovers. Config flags: tempered_circuit_v1 (boolean), circuit.jitter_ms (int), throttle.sanitizer_window_ms (int).
post_deploy_actions: 1) Monitor grafana panel 'circuit_flip_rate' and 'tenant_sanitizer_rejections' for 48 hours; 2) Run rollback_probe.sh if flip_rate increases > 2x baseline; 3) Postmortem if any customer-facing degradation is detected.
audit_log: Added short-lived transition snapshots to infra-audit with hashed tenant ids; sampling at 10% by default.
notes_for_oncall: If alerts 'SLO:region_flip_spike' or 'SLO:tenant_sanitizer_spike' fire, toggle helm flag tempered_circuit_v1=false and re-run rollout; contact author and Marco for immediate tooling help.
